_derivation.source: Milestone-0 Appendix B AIPerf target sheet (OpenRouter competitive analysis + BH-Galaxy projection).
_derivation.graded_metrics: Graded on the two concurrency-independent per-request metrics: TTFT and interactivity (per-user decode throughput, tput_user). Aggregate decode throughput is a per-system steady-state figure (6413 t/s) and is left ungraded here so the bar does not move with the sweep point's concurrency.

tiers.target: Full performance. tput_user = target interactivity 100 t/s/u. ttft = target_mean_isl * max_num_seqs / prefill_tput = 8192*64/371835 = 1.410 s.
tiers.functional: Downrated bar (sheet downrate factors: interactivity x0.25, prefill x0.50). tput_user = 25 t/s/u. ttft = 8192*64/185918 = 2.820 s.

_derivation.note: complete tier intentionally omitted: the sheet defines only the full and downrated bars. Replace/extend when the RFP tiering is finalized (#66/#67).
